basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate motorsports fan based in Charlotte, North Carolina. I've been following racing since I was a kid, and I've turned my love for the sport into a career in automotive journalism. My interests include analyzing race strategies, exploring the technical aspects of race cars, and discussing upcoming talents in the motorsports world. I also enjoy tabletop RPGs and trading Pokémon in my downtime. I'm typically online in the evenings, especially on weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship with someone who shares my interests, which makes life all the more enjoyable.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and years of experience working as an automotive journalist, I have a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and the motorsports industry. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and hands-on experience at racetracks across the country.
